prologue.speaker: narrator
prologue.text: The Forest has kept Father's trail for three long winters.

prologue.speaker: arin
prologue.text: Bram, Cora, Dain, Wren—stay close. We find his path, then we find him.

prologue.speaker: bram
prologue.text: He went west with a map and a stubborn plan. That sounds like him.

prologue.speaker: cora
prologue.text: And Wren went with him. Wren came back alone, carrying the journal but no memory of the road.

prologue.speaker: dain
prologue.text: Then we search every Layer until the Forest gives us an answer.

prologue.speaker: wren
prologue.text: I remember leaving with him. After that… only trees, thorns, and a voice asking for a life.

prologue.speaker: narrator
prologue.text: Together, the Party steps beneath the ancient boughs.

chapters.title: The First Trees
chapters.subtitle: A trail of old ash leads into the Forest.

chapters.title: Marks in the Bark
chapters.subtitle: Father left signs, but something followed them.

chapters.title: The Forgotten Road
chapters.subtitle: Wren's missing memories begin to stir.

chapters.title: Past the Last Light
chapters.subtitle: The way west narrows beneath thorn and shadow.

chapters.title: The Guardian's Gate
chapters.subtitle: The cave beneath the Forest will not yield its secrets freely.

chapters.title: Guardian Beneath the Forest
chapters.subtitle: Face the Elder Thornwarden in the cave beneath the Forest.

first_combat_won.speaker: bram
first_combat_won.text: One fight down. The Forest is testing us already.

first_combat_won.speaker: cora
first_combat_won.text: Look at those tracks. They point deeper in, toward the stream.

first_combat_won.speaker: wren
first_combat_won.text: Father always followed water west. I can almost see his lantern.

first_combat_won.speaker: arin
first_combat_won.text: Then we follow it too. Nobody gets left behind this time.

class_gained.speaker: dain
class_gained.text: That power answered you. It is yours now.

class_gained.speaker: wren
class_gained.text: Father said a Class was a promise: to choose how you protect the people beside you.

class_gained.speaker: cora
class_gained.text: A useful promise. We still have a long road ahead.

story_clue.speaker: cora
story_clue.text: Another mark from Father. A wave, a lighthouse, and an upside-down cup.

story_clue.speaker: bram
story_clue.text: He was pointing beyond the Forest. Past the last lighthouse.

story_clue.speaker: wren
story_clue.text: The cup… I remember him saying the Chalice asks a price.

story_clue.speaker: arin
story_clue.text: We learn the price before anyone pays it. Keep moving.

merchant_first.speaker: bram
merchant_first.text: A merchant in a forest this deep? I am not asking questions.

merchant_first.speaker: dain
merchant_first.text: Spend the Party's Gold carefully. We may not see another stall.

merchant_first.speaker: wren
merchant_first.text: Father traded for supplies before the Guardian. He knew the way would be hard.

rest_first.speaker: cora
rest_first.text: A quiet camp at last. Let the wounds close before we go on.

rest_first.speaker: wren
rest_first.text: This feels familiar. Two bedrolls beneath a pine… and Father's knot in the rope.

rest_first.speaker: arin
rest_first.text: Rest while we can. Tomorrow, the trail climbs.

before_boss.speaker: narrator
before_boss.text: The roots part, revealing a cave blackened by old fire.

before_boss.speaker: wren
before_boss.text: I came this far before. I remember the green eyes. I remember running.

before_boss.speaker: bram
before_boss.text: Then this time we stand together.

before_boss.speaker: arin
before_boss.text: Father crossed this gate—or tried to. We finish what he began.

boss_won.speaker: narrator
boss_won.text: The Elder Thornwarden sinks into the earth, becoming an old tree once more.

boss_won.speaker: cora
boss_won.text: There—in the roots. A compass, still pointing west.

boss_won.speaker: wren
boss_won.text: I remember his voice now: Keep going. Don't wait for me.

boss_won.speaker: arin
boss_won.text: We will find him. The road beyond the Forest is open.

party_defeated.speaker: narrator
party_defeated.text: The cave beneath the Forest closes around the fallen Party.

party_defeated.speaker: wren
party_defeated.text: Father waited three winters. We can gather our strength and try again.

party_defeated.speaker: arin
party_defeated.text: Next time, we reach the Guardian in the cave together.
